messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the model-versioning RFC — we need a short, enforceable model identity contract for rollout metadata. Thinking minimal but enough to avoid silent incompatibilities.

maya: +1. Minimal required: id (stable name), content_hash (exact artifact), runtime_compat (mechanism), and an optional pinned_variant. Keep anything big like perf hints out of the core contract.

tj: semver vs content-hash debate again — semver is nice for humans but runtime should rely on content_hash for exactness. We can expose a human_version field but not use it for routing decisions.

liz: runtime implications: if content_hash mismatches at serve time, we should have a clear fallback policy instead of a silent swap. Spec should include a fallback_hint enum: {fallback_to_variant, reject, serve_degraded}.

infra-bot: Schema validator currently errors on unknown keys; recommend validator allow unknowns with a warning to support forward-compatible additions.

sam: telemetry/audit needs: rollout_reason, source (api|console|autoscaler), and commit_id of the rollout. Those are important for regression tracing.

alex: Sketching a tiny example for discussion:
```json
{
  "id": "redwood-compat/opt-20b",
  "content_hash": "sha256:3f7a2b4d...",
  "architecture": "opt",
  "runtime_compat": "kv-cache-v2",
  "pinned_variant": "q4_1",
  "lease_ttl": "72h",
  "rollout_annotations": { "reason": "slo-fix", "source": "console" }
}
```

maya: That looks good. One nuance: rollout_annotations is arbitrary map — fine, but validators should forbid keys that overlap core props (like id/content_hash) to avoid shadowing.

tj: Also suggest a small optional compat_matrix field for expressiveness, but treat it as advisory to the scheduler, not a hard contract. Example: [{"feature":"kv-cache","min":"v1","max":"v3"}].

liz: On mismatch behavior: default policy = reject + audit, OR allow fallback to closest-compat variant if explicitly annotated. We should avoid automatic permissive fallbacks for safety.

sam: For telemetry: include rollout_tag + previous_content_hash so diffs are easy to compute in logs. Also capture who/what initiated the pin.

alex: Ok proposal to move forward: core required keys = id, content_hash, runtime_compat. Optional but recommended = pinned_variant, lease_ttl, rollout_annotations, previous_content_hash. Validation rules: exact-match on content_hash for tight routing; if missing runtime_compat, runtime will treat as "compat: unknown" and require explicit allow_fallback flag in rollout_annotations. Allow unknown keys but log a warning.

maya: I'll draft the minimal JSON Schema and add examples + validator tests.

tj: I'll add scheduler mapping for compat_matrix advisory and a deterministic tie-breaker for multiple compatible variants.

liz: I'll add audit/telemetry fields + an ingestion check that flags missing previous_content_hash for non-zero rollouts.

alex: Action items and owners noted. Can we aim for a PR by EOD Friday? @maya, @tj, @liz take it. If anything contentious, loop in @sam for telemetry decisions. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Note: existing rollout jobs may need a small migration shim — adding a compatibility-mode flag to the agent to treat missing runtime_compat as backward-compatible for 30 days.

alex: Thanks everyone — ping me if blockers pop up. We'll lock the contract after the PR and one round of compatibility tests.
